text.p: Shenyin & Wanguo Securities, China's top brokerage, on Tuesday recommended the B shares of construction materials firm Shenzhen Fangda Industry Co Ltd as a "buy", saying it is set to grow strongly in the next two years.
The brokerage said in a research paper that Fangda's products, in particular curtain wall glass, were eligible for special support from the central government.

China now produces 400 to 500 million square metres of curtain wall glass each year but output is far short of demand leading to big imports to cover shortages especially in the coastal areas and major cities, Shenyin said.
Shenzhen Fangda has grown surprisingly fast in the past two years with turnover rising by 150.32 percent in 1996 against 1995 and net profit increasing by 157 percent.
The company set up two new production lines in 1996 which will go into trial operation in May 1997 and will become a significant source of revenue in 1998, the research paper said.
"The firm's economic data reflects a healthy enterprise growing well and implies it is still in a stage of rapid development," it said.
By the end of April, the company had orders for its curtain wall glass worth 4.1 billion yuan for 1997 which will allow it to run at full capacity, the research paper said.
